कल से होगा Form Correction शुरू ✅

IBPS PO MT XVI Correction / Edit Form 2026

  • Start Date : 29 July 2026
  • Last Date : 30 July 2026
  • Total : 7365 Posts

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the correction / edit window for CRP PO/MT-XVI.

Online registration was open from 01 July 2026 to 26 July 2026 (extended). Candidates who already applied can edit application details during the correction window only.

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 01 July 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 26 July 2026 (Extended)
  • Correction / Edit Form : 29 – 30 July 2026
  • Prelims Exam : August 2026 (tentative)
  • Prelims Admit Card : Before exam

How to Correct / Edit Form

  1. Open https://www.ibps.in
  2. Open CRP PO/MT-XVI Online Correction link (activates on 29 July 2026)
  3. Login with Registration Number and Password
  4. Edit allowed fields, verify carefully, and submit
  5. Take printout of the corrected application

Correction window is only for 2 days (29–30 July 2026). Official portal: ibps.in
